semantics.default_rule: Default pre-conversation throttle may be configured, e.g. one request per week, but remains explicit policy.

semantics.delivery_rule: Throttled/rejected request does not enter normal conversation history as accepted message unless profile says so.
semantics.authority_rule: Throttle clearance grants messaging request eligibility only.
